cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: Bring a small tool if the tent pole will not fit.
cards.example_zh: 如果帐篷杆装不上，就带一把小工具来。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：对待；治疗
cards.example_en: Nurses treat small cuts in the school medical room.
cards.example_zh: 护士在学校医务室里治疗小伤口。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: The vet isolated the hen so the disease would not reach the others.
cards.example_zh: 兽医把那只母鸡隔开，免得病传到其余的鸡身上。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：令人厌恶的
cards.example_en: The disgusting mould on the bread meant we threw it away.
cards.example_zh: 面包上恶心的霉让我们把它扔掉了。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: A skin infection kept him out of the swimming pool.
cards.example_zh: 皮肤感染让他不能去游泳池。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：主动行动
cards.example_en: She took the initiative and booked the room for our meeting.
cards.example_zh: 她采取主动行动，为我们的会议订好了房间。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: Living on the farm gave me insight into how crops grow.
cards.example_zh: 住在农场让我明白了庄稼是怎么生长的。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: The bakery premises include a small room upstairs.
cards.example_zh: 这家面包店的房屋包括楼上的一个小房间。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：最近的
cards.example_en: A recent storm broke several branches in the park.
cards.example_zh: 最近的一场暴风雨折断了公园里的几根树枝。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: You might recognize that song from the school concert.
cards.example_zh: 你也许能认出那首学校音乐会上的歌。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: It took him a week to recover from that bad cold.
cards.example_zh: 他过了一周才从那场重感冒中恢复过来。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：不管怎样

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: Sleep and test marks show a clear relation in our class.
cards.example_zh: 在我们班，睡眠和考试成绩呈现出明显的关系。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：不太可能的
cards.example_en: Rain looks unlikely, so we will walk to school.
cards.example_zh: 看起来不太会下雨，所以我们走路去学校。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：积极的；主动的
cards.example_en: She takes an active part in the class debate.
